Crowds may affect effort, communication and officiating. Better teams also attract more fans, so attendance–win correlations need not be causal.

New samples: calendar 2001–2019, regular season, valid positive attendance, decisive score and complete pregame controls. NFL supplies the 22.94% closeness anchor.

The original previous-game-closeness design
HISTORICAL DESIGN
Sources: scripts/first_stage.py; results/first_stage/report.md; README.md
04
Prior close game → fan interest → current attendance → home-team result
Separate instruments: did the current home team’s and away team’s immediately previous games end close?
Why it seemed plausible
Suspense may raise demand before the next game. Score-margin cutoffs have a simple interpretation across leagues.
Why validity was unresolved
Closeness can reflect team quality, fatigue and momentum. Those channels may change the next result directly.
NFL reference: |score margin| ≤ 3 in 1,103 / 4,808 games (22.94%). The same percentile maps to ≤ 1 MLB run and ≤ 5 NBA points; discrete shares differ.

Weekend validity remains the central limitation
Sources: expanded_candidate_report.md; new data_audit.json and analysis_plan.md; research update report
11
Weekend changes more than fan availability
Rest and travel
Days off do not fully measure fatigue, distance or time-zone changes.
Game timing
Adding recorded hour changes NBA IV from −1.09 to −0.41 pp; its pregame status is unverified.
Schedule selection
Matchups and high-demand games may be assigned selectively.
Date FE would remove common daily shocks—and the instrument itself.
Other limits: exploratory candidate/threshold search, about 30 home-team clusters, attendance measurement and sellouts, stored NBA date/time convention, and MLB gate attribution in doubleheaders.

Current conclusions and next steps

12
Completed previously
Cleaned MLB/NBA samples; weak closeness first stages; broad alternative-IV search.
Completed in this update
Preliminary OLS, reduced form and 2SLS for both leagues; sensitivity estimates and weak-IV-robust intervals. Exclusion remains unresolved.
Next priorities
Audit rest, travel and timing balance; validate attendance and dates; strengthen the exclusion argument before causal claims.
Weekend is a useful working candidate. Its causal interpretation remains conditional.
NFL remains calibration only; a separate league design is planned.
